home.brandIntro.statement: We design a small number of T-shirts and refine them until they feel inevitable. Versatile silhouettes, balanced proportions and a quiet palette — made to be reached for, worn often, and lived in.
home.brandIntro.alt: A white tee hanging on a minimal rail in soft daylight
home.brandIntro.caption: Fig. 01 — The Daily Tee, Optic White
home.brandIntro.body: Every piece starts with fit. Oversized or regular, each silhouette is shaped to sit naturally on the body and pair easily with what you already own — the foundation of an everyday wardrobe.

page.about.heroAlt: A woman holding a white tee on a hanger beneath twin plaster arches
page.about.ideaLead: {store} began with a simple question: what if a T-shirt was designed with the same attention usually reserved for tailoring? We started with fit, kept the palette quiet, and let proportion do the talking.
page.about.ideaBody1: The result is a small collection built on two silhouettes — oversized and regular — each refined until the shoulder sits right, the sleeve falls cleanly and the hem lands where it should.
page.about.ideaBody2: We think the best wardrobe staples are the ones you stop thinking about: pieces that work with everything, every day, without asking for attention. That’s what we set out to make.
page.about.sideAlt: Model in a black tee against a weathered concrete wall

principles.title: Fewer, better pieces

principles.title: A palette that works together
principles.body: Quiet neutrals and a few considered tones, chosen so every piece pairs with the rest.

policies.title: Shipping & returns
policies.body:
We deliver across India. Shipping is complimentary above a minimum order value, shown in your bag and at checkout.

Return and exchange timelines, delivery partners and conditions will be published here before launch.

policies.title: Privacy policy
policies.body:
To run the store we keep your account details, delivery addresses and order history, and — only if you sign up — your email for the newsletter, which you can ask us to remove at any time. Card and UPI payments are handled by our payment partner, Razorpay; we never see or store your card details.

A full privacy policy will be published here before launch.

product.sizeGuide.intro: Garment measurements in centimetres, measured flat.
